title: Jamie Lynn White (strategy & ops, OpenAI) closed the Responsive fireside with an oath: 'I have power. I don't want my organization to become corrupt. I will do something about it.'
summary: Jamie Lynn White — strategy & ops at OpenAI, former chief of staff at Notion and Grammarly — writes up moderating the Responsive Conference fireside with Eric. She works through financial gravity, presses him on why more knowledge workers don't unionize, and ends by asking hundreds of attendees to repeat an oath back to her.
blockquote:
Which is how I ended up closing our conversation by asking a room full of people to repeat after me:
I have power. I don't want my organization to become corrupt. I will do something about it.
attribution_title: Strategy & Ops, OpenAI · Former Chief of Staff, Notion and Grammarly
